when: 2026-08-03, taken on origin/main (a180b32) before any edit of this branch
what: The half of the post-combat symptom that has nothing to do with the jam: how much of the cohort stands still after a fight because there is nothing to do. Issue #201 asks for the same measurement as #186 so that before and after are comparable; this file is the 'before'.
theOwnersWords: Существо без работы должно возвращаться куда-то — в покои или на пост, — а не стоять там, где кончилась драка.

meaning.cohortTicks: creature-ticks observed over every post-combat window, cohort = everybody still Fighting on the tick before the wave ended
meaning.idleAndStill: creature-ticks with no step taken and no refusal recorded — the creature was not blocked by anything, it had nothing to do

whatTheStillOnesWereDoing.note: LastDecision can be several ticks stale for a creature that took no decision on the tick being read — named by #186 and not re-measured here.

whatThisReproduces: Every number above is quoted by Issue #201 from the measurement of #186. Reproducing them on this branch's base is the point of the file: the 'after' measurement is only comparable if the 'before' is the same run.

whatIsOutOfScope.refused_zone_unreachable: 232 of the 1121 idle Waiting ticks are 'I cannot reach the zone', not 'there is no work'. #201 must not be credited with moving them and must not be confused with them.
whatIsOutOfScope.cellOccupancy: #76 stays on slice 6 by the owner's decision of 2026-08-03; the jam itself is not fixed here.
